worldcombat.skill.covet.summary: Sidle up sweetly, then let the strike soften the target's swing; with empty hands, it also slips the target's held item into your grasp. Higher friendship makes the charm land more naturally.
worldcombat.skill.covet.use.0: Close in and take the target's held item
worldcombat.skill.covet.use.1: Wear down one target's offence with a lasting charm
worldcombat.skill.covet.use.2: An ordinary close strike while empty-handed
worldcombat.skill.covet.description.0: The sidle deals about %1$s Normal contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.covet.description.1: Slide up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; a landed hit eases the target about %3$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.covet.description.2: Each landed hit lowers the target's Attack by %1$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.covet.polite.on: Polite on: the strike is lighter (x0.85), but the target's Attack drops 2 stages, trading damage for a deeper charm.
worldcombat.skill.covet.polite.off: Polite off: the strike is heavier (x1.1), but the target's Attack drops only 1 stage.
worldcombat.skill.covet.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.covet.growth.0: At level %1$s, Covet power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.covet.growth.1: At level %1$s, Covet power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.covet.preference.polit: On: the strike is lighter (x0.85) but drops the target's Attack 2 stages; off: heavier (x1.1) but only 1 stage.
worldcombat.skill.covet.preference.ai.ma: Only sidle in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.covet.preference.ai.le: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to sidle in. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.covet.preference.ai.st: On: only used when the target carries a held item, as a dedicated steal. Off: it also fills in as an ordinary close strike.
worldcombat.skill.covet.description.addi: When your own hands are empty, the strike also slips the target's held item into your grasp; if you already hold something, the target holds nothing, or either side is sealed, it only lands as an ordinary strike that still lowers Attack.
